messages:
deploy-bot: [ROLLOUT START] v3.0.0-beta -> US (slice-b) 8% traffic. Canary window = 12m. Rollback triggers: errors > 4% for 3m, p95 > 400ms. deploy id: dr-1764189001.

rachael: US preflight done. GC sweep completed, warm-pool verified: 36 GPUs available (mix A100/GPUx), reserved 10. disk pressure low.

kai: queue depth nominal 0.7, avg inference latency p50=50ms, p95=145ms baseline. cache hit 19%.

ops-bot: Note: scheduled DB migration in EU at +35m -> may affect EU rollout.

tom: keeping EU pinned. also APAC ops said they'll be on a holiday cadence, so slower response. plan APAC for late window.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics (US): 3m in: errors 0.9%, p95 160ms. No manual action.

rachael: running a short wrk profile: `wrk -t8 -c80 -d30s http://canary-us.slice-b/repl` — will share perf.

diego: small spike in model shard mem pressure at +5m on host g5-22, restarted process, no errors surfaced.

sre-oncall: adding watch: OOM_retries metric. If OOM_retries > 5 within 10m then we pause.

deploy-bot: [UPDATE] US canary -> 25% after approval. Metrics: p95=170ms, errors=1.1%. No auto rollback.

rachael: smoke check payloads ok. example response times: 42ms, 58ms, 61ms.

kai: noticed increased tail lat for long-context prompts only. p95 for >2048 tokens is closer to 420ms. that's above trigger.

diego: that's the shard that handles long-context routing. I'll temporarily route long-context requests to spare shard pool to mitigate.

deploy-bot: [MANUAL INTERVENTION] throttling long-context to 2% traffic while mitigation in progress.

rachael: good call. reduce canary ramp until we confirm tail mitigation.

tom: EU still pinned due to DB window. suggest EU start +1h after DB window completes.

ops-bot: APAC tentative green at +90m but please expect slower handoff.

deploy-bot: [STATUS] US canary paused at 25% (long-context throttle). rollback ready: `deploybot rollback --id dr-1764189001 --to v2.9.x`

rachael: I'll run another load test focused on long-context after diego's routing change.

kai: after routing change, observed p95 for long-context drop to 210ms on tests. still above baseline but under the 400ms trigger.

diego: routing persisted. will monitor cache warming effects for next 15m.

sre-oncall: starting 15m observation. if OOM_retries or tail errors surface we abort.

deploy-bot: [CANARY RESUME] US -> 40% after manual approval. metrics: errors=1.6%, p95=190ms.

rachael: filing interim release note: "v3.0.0-beta - staged rollout: US slice-b canary progressed; long-context routing mitigated; EU/ APAC scheduling pending." link: https://confluence/releases/v3.0.0-beta

tom: remind PMs to add note about degraded latency for >2k token prompts; include mitigation steps.

deploy-bot: [CANARY COMPLETE] US slice-b 60% traffic. No auto rollback triggered. EU pinned; APAC scheduled for later window. Closing thread once APAC canary starts.

rachael: thanks all. leaving notes for follow-on handoff and runbook: https://infra.internal/runbooks/rollout-v3-beta

sre-oncall: watch continues for 30m post-canary. will open incident if regressions exceed thresholds.
